Make sure KA users on /contact see the Georgian address copy (currently the ContactPage hard-codes the English address '0102 Tsereteli Ave. 118, Tbilisi, Georgia' regardless of lang).
Header lacks a data-testid on the main <nav> element; individual links do have testids — fine for current coverage.
Hero stat badge 'Free SmartPaw Feeder for 150GEL+ packages' overlaps slightly with hero image on 1920px — minor visual polish, not blocking.
